title: DivAlgo: A systematic evaluation of algorithmic diversity for code generation models
abstract: arXiv:2610.19157v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Code generation models are actively being used in professional and educational settings. However, the competence of large language models (LLMs) to generate algorithmically diverse code remains largely unknown. We propose the DivAlgo benchmark, a large-scale dataset constituting algorithmically diverse solutions to programming problems. We also introduce a lightweight similarity metric to enable large-scale evaluation. Our experiments across 24 modern code generation models found that uncontrolled model-generated code is significantly less diverse than human solutions (capturing ~31% of human diversity), and even the best diverse code generation strategy could achieve only ~70% of human diversity. Moreover, while it was possible to steer the models to generate solutions based on human strategies, they were unable to reproduce the diversity of the human solutions. translated_title: DivAlgo：代码生成模型算法多样性的系统性评估
translated_abstract: 代码生成模型正被积极应用于专业和教育场景中。然而，大型语言模型（LLM）生成算法多样性代码的能力在很大程度上仍不为人知。我们提出了DivAlgo基准，这是一个包含针对编程问题的算法多样化解决方案的大规模数据集。我们还引入了一种轻量级的相似度度量方法，以支持大规模评估。我们在24个现代代码生成模型上的实验发现，不受控制的模型生成代码的多样性显著低于人类解决方案（仅捕捉到人类多样性的约31%），即使是最佳的多样性代码生成策略也只能达到人类多样性的约70%。此外，虽然可以引导模型基于人类策略生成解决方案，但它们无法再现人类解决方案的多样性。这些发现表明代码生成模型在捕捉算法多样性方面存在局限。
tldr: 提出DivAlgo基准数据集及轻量级相似度度量方法，通过对24个代码生成模型的评估发现，模型生成代码的算法多样性显著低于人类解决方案（最高仅达人类多样性的约70%），揭示了当前代码生成模型在算法多样性方面的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DivAlgo, a benchmark with a lightweight similarity metric, and finds through evaluation of 24 code generation models that their outputs are significantly less algorithmically diverse than human solutions (best strategies reaching only ~70% of human diversity), revealing fundamental limitations of code generation models.
